potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User accesses the API documentation to understand available endpoints and their configurations.

steps.element_description: Click on API Docs link to enter documentation.
Go through details of each endpoint and their corresponding request samples.

expected_outcome: User gains understanding of API functionalities and usage.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User downloads the OpenAPI specification file for integration purposes.

steps.element_description: Click on the 'Download OpenAPI specification' button.

expected_outcome: User obtains the OpenAPI specification file.
